results.title: The 22 Best Indian Independent Singles of 2022
results.content: [![]()![](https://rollingstoneindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/fom-top-bar-mobile.png)](https://rollingstoneindia.com/future-of-music-2025/) [Artists](https://rollingstoneindia.com/category/artists/amp/ "Artists") # **The 22 Best Indian Independent Singles of 2022** Artists from all corners of the country were at the top of their game this year, and we picked the best tracks that they produced Published by [Anurag Tagat and David Britto](https://rollingstoneindia.com/author/anurag-tagat-and-david-britto/amp/ "Posts by Anurag Tagat and David Britto") December 28, 2022 ![The 22 Best Indian Independent Singles of 2022 ](https://rollingstoneindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/singles.jpg) **22\. BeBhumika, Katoptris — “Pareshaan”** Pareshaan - faizal, Bhumi \| Spotify ![Pareshaan cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e025f0ee59746ae9b287c8526aa) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/5SvAonia2IhHVX4aFLUFCM?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Pareshaan](https://open.spotify.com/track/5SvAonia2IhHVX4aFLUFCM?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [faizal](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3iMtnIUSnojtxLhlP294k4?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5), [Bhumi](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6ze415xN4HqPmAhj1P4pRl?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/5SvAonia2IhHVX4aFLUFCM?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Among the songs that would’ve turned up on any streaming algorithm’s shuffle mode, [BeBhumika](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=BeBhumika+) and [Katoptris](https://rollingstoneindia.com/exclusive-premiere-hear-pune-producer-katoptris-new-lo-fi-single-take-the-pill/) deal with the frustrations of Gen Z forgetfulness, anxieties and modern existence on their Hindi song “Pareshaan.” In just about two-and-a-half minutes, we see confessional lyrics, cheery pop beats and BeBhumika’s soulful croon.  — _AT_ **21\. The Runway – “Find Me Find You”** Find Me Find You - THE RUNWAY \| Spotify ![Find Me Find You cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e023fbe416de091593b4769a21b) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/7G6oWYG2hDMX9PagdHFY32?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Find Me Find You](https://open.spotify.com/track/7G6oWYG2hDMX9PagdHFY32?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [THE RUNWAY](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6RudEx94S8MrT9CRA6aP6w?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/7G6oWYG2hDMX9PagdHFY32?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Nagaland-based synth-pop band [The Runway](https://rollingstoneindia.com/the-runway-release-new-synth-pop-single-find-me-find-you/) deliver a buoyant track filled with glitzy guitar parts, an airy drum and bass groove and, of course, flavorful synths while the honeyed lead vocals also stand out for catchy melodies and effervescent performance on their upbeat offering “Find Me Find You.” _– DB_ **20\. Mali — “Ashes”** Ashes - Mali \| Spotify ![Ashes cover](https://image-cdn-ak.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02de6e63946350df8d3c52108d) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/23il79F7rw8gQmcCNYFQsD?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Ashes](https://open.spotify.com/track/23il79F7rw8gQmcCNYFQsD?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Mali](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4JSAaGJ5mNSfG0MBxDFQZN?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/23il79F7rw8gQmcCNYFQsD?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Singer-songwriter [Mali](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Mali+) finds her way out of heartbreak and like most of us, it’s not easy. That’s what she’s admitting on “Ashes,” her latest single which looks back at a relationship that ended last year. Warm guitar and piano arrangements put the song’s focus squarely on Mali’s lyrics: “Hope you’re happier now/ Cuz I’m nearly insane.” — _AT_ **19\. Kenneth Soares – “Cigarettes”** Cigarettes - Kenneth Soares \| Spotify ![Cigarettes cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02ebd37bf415ad7b381cfffbc2) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/66n5mf1p4CxwBn44HKSQSa?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&t=17&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Cigarettes](https://open.spotify.com/track/66n5mf1p4CxwBn44HKSQSa?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&t=17&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Kenneth Soares](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7JNZS32nbUQnROsWzwbamV?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/66n5mf1p4CxwBn44HKSQSa?go=1&sp_cid=838879cdf7c5152c096f81c54ed0b7f5&t=17&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Mumbai singer-songwriter [Kenneth Soares](https://rollingstoneindia.com/ambition-and-restlessness-led-to-kenneth-soares-new-single-cigarettes/)’ breezy single “Cigarettes” is neatly woven with funky guitar stabs, chunky and groovy basslines, lively drums, sparkly keyboard parts, melodic guitar lines and a sizzling solo as well as Soares’ timber voice. On the track, the musician says, “‘Cigarettes’ is the product of ambition and restlessness.” _– DB_ **18\. Tanmaya Bhatnagar – “kyun hota hai?”** kyun hota hai? - Tanmaya Bhatnagar \| Spotify ![kyun hota hai? cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02a63abee7e7898441d7ca2c7a) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/1AwVVK2Qxqwmm0hxj5d8Gs?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [kyun hota hai?](https://open.spotify.com/track/1AwVVK2Qxqwmm0hxj5d8Gs?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Tanmaya Bhatnagar](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1kzKlwoZunQPBWRLCZ7ZvS?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/1AwVVK2Qxqwmm0hxj5d8Gs?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) New Delhi singer-songwriter [Tanmaya Bhatnagar](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Tanmaya+Bhatnagar)’s soft-pop track “kyun hota hai?” showcases her contemporary side with its eclectic soundscapes while the artist’s smooth harmonies against the playful production make it quite the earworm. _– DB_ **17\. Gaya — “Qisse”** Qisse - Gaya \| Spotify ![Qisse cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02ae4a4378b25b7525c38a3909) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/6OIhBTJqavscdACHx7rJ0R?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Qisse](https://open.spotify.com/track/6OIhBTJqavscdACHx7rJ0R?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Gaya](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3mP82vJNOQmr2EZNxxajl3?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/6OIhBTJqavscdACHx7rJ0R?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Returning after a five-year hiatus earlier this year, Dubai-based, Chennai-born artist [Gaya](https://rollingstoneindia.com/watch-gaya-qisse-video/) penned a heartfelt song about ambitions, desires and all the tangles in between for “Qisse.” The title track off her upcoming album, Gaya’s way with tender vocal melodies and a spirited hook makes this a cozy, inspiring song to put on your morning playlist. — _AT_ **16\. Raghav Meattle – “Am I Overthinking This?”** Am I Overthinking This? - Raghav Meattle \| Spotify ![Am I Overthinking This? cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e022ca495cf9a6324ffd23835a4) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/0nHm0hPOwDYwwCbZUs0XKv?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=21&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [Am I Overthinking This?](https://open.spotify.com/track/0nHm0hPOwDYwwCbZUs0XKv?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=21&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Raghav Meattle](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7lTlD9L3QhfOH13Z0n1ibN?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/0nHm0hPOwDYwwCbZUs0XKv?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=21&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Mumbai-based singer-songwriter [Raghav Meattle](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Raghav+Meattle) began the year by releasing his delicate track called “Am I Overthinking This?” It features quaint acoustic guitar parts, melodic whistling, Meattle’s tender voice and poignant lyrics. The song also marked Meattle’s debut as a producer and he says, “I wrote this song about my mental health a few years ago and the loneliness that comes with being an artist.” _– DB_ **15\. Anoushka Maskey – “So Long, Already. Again.”** So Long, Already. Again. - Anoushka Maskey \| Spotify ![So Long, Already. Again. cover](https://image-cdn-ak.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e0238634a8688e4d9389a1c3303) [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/0H609W1kZ5AMzbREQ8G7DY?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=11&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop "Play on Spotify") # [So Long, Already. Again.](https://open.spotify.com/track/0H609W1kZ5AMzbREQ8G7DY?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=11&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) PreviewE ## [Anoushka Maskey](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2nDgCBr8jDMiGFjTkwR6ph?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66) Save on Spotify - [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/0H609W1kZ5AMzbREQ8G7DY?go=1&sp_cid=817f1d8fd2a64c94c4e4bbf4a3726d66&t=11&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop) - Save on Spotify - Copy link [Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal) Over the last two years, Mumbai/Sikkim singer-songwrite [r Anoushka Maskey](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Anoushka+Maskey) has been churning out music consistently. This year’s single came wrapped neatly in a soulful and dreamy offering called “So Long, Already. Again.” The track features melodic guitar lines throughout while lush production touches keep it engaging as Maskey’s mellifluous vocals add to the treat that is “So Long, Already. # The Best Indian Indie Songs of 2023 So Far

From Raftaar and Prabh Deep’s surprise collaboration to the return of Donn Bhat and evocative sonic snapshots of time by Kamakshi Khanna, Aditi Ramesh and more, here are songs that kept us hooked, in no order or rank

Published by

[Anurag Tagat and David Britto](https://rollingstoneindia.com/author/anurag-tagat-and-david-britto/amp/ "Posts by Anurag Tagat and David Britto")

July 6, 2023

![The Best Indian Indie Songs of 2023 So Far  ](https://rollingstoneindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Best-so-far-of-2023-scaled.jpg)

**Long Distances — “Lovesong for an Apocalpyse”**

Mumbai indie-rock outfit [Long Distances](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=+Long+Distances) – comprising vocalist Aarifah Rebello, guitarist-producer Apurv Agrawal and guitarist-producer Zubin Pastakia – released their sophomore single in the shape of the journeying “Lovesong for an Apocalypse.” It has catchy vocals, a groovy bass line, hooky guitar parts and more, and is off the band’s upcoming debut EP _How the Mighty Will Fall_. The group also tapped seasoned Mumbai drummer Jai Row Kavi to sit behind the kit for the track, and even worked with bassist-producer Krishna Jhaveri as well as producer Sandunes who provided additional synths to the song. – _D.B._

**Dot. — “Indigo”**

Indigo - Dot. \| Spotify

![Indigo cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02038c61406c958f009b333b79)

# [Indigo](https://open.spotify.com/track/7mlGKWXA5ZV6HZibmRruqD?go=1&sp_cid=bb377cfed346c04eff291309c1a62a9e&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop)

New Delhi-bred and Bengaluru-based singer-songwriter Aditi Saigal aka [Dot.](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Dot.+) released a fresh single earlier this year, the easy-going pop-folk song “Indigo.” The fabulously written track includes slick production, quirky lyrics, Dot.’s breezy and smooth vocal delivery and more. – _D.B._

**Yungsta x Sez On The Beat — “Ruhbaru”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/b5lj2s7MfzI/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

New Delhi hip-hop artist [Yungsta](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Yungsta) tells his story in a whole new way on “Ruhbaru,” the lead single and opening song off his album _MEEN_, produced by [Sez on the Beat](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Sez+on+the+Beat). The confessional tone is sharp and delivered with a conviction that says he wouldn’t change a thing about his journey so far and it’s capped off by a starry guitar solo. _– A.T._

**Tejas — “Some Kind of Nothing”**

Some Kind Of Nothing - Tejas \| Spotify

![Some Kind Of Nothing cover](https://image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com/image/ab67616d00001e02c8a79dc2f62f0b3a2cc168af)

# [Some Kind Of Nothing](https://open.spotify.com/track/2ND8gHcSdiXH2rZx82qzqu?go=1&sp_cid=bb377cfed346c04eff291309c1a62a9e&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop)

- [Play on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/2ND8gHcSdiXH2rZx82qzqu?go=1&sp_cid=bb377cfed346c04eff291309c1a62a9e&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop)
- Save on Spotify

[Privacy Policy](https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/)· [Terms & Conditions](https://www.spotify.com/legal)

With “Some Kind Of Nothing,” Mumbai-based singer-songwriter [Tejas](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Tejas+) delves deeper into the pop realm with bubblegum soundscapes, upbeat and catchy melodies, slick production, honeyed vocals, harmonies and more. The track also features Tejas’ longtime bandmates, drummer Jehangir Jehangir and bassist Adil Kurwa. – _D.B._

**Raftaar x Prabh Deep — “TRAP PRAA”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/QqyuVF1u7_Y/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

One of the best surprises in Indian hip-hop came with the announcement and drop of [Raftaar](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Raftaar+) and [Prabh Deep](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Prabh+Deep)’s collaborative EP _PRAA_. Across four tracks, one of the most shape-shifting Punjabi artists of our times and a rap frontrunner like Raftaar ran riot without a care for boundaries. The song “TRAP PRAA,” however, encapsulates just the kind of sparks that fly on a powerful collaboration like this. _– A.T._

**Hanumankind ft. Parimal Shais — “Go To Sleep”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/uXNEN-hGkZU/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

Rapper Hanumankind and producer [Parimal Shais](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Parimal+Shais) joined forces on the explosive “Go To Sleep.” The track includes a dancey yet in-your-face beat influenced by South Indian soundscapes while Hanumankind delivers hard-hitting rhymes about wrestler Jeff Hardy, _Fight Club_ and more. _– D.B._

**Irfana — “Sheila Silk”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/7l1Gimj_WzI/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

Kodaikanal-bred rapper [Irfana](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Irfana)’s first release via Def Jam India is the hypnotic “Sheila Silk.” The track includes a gritty beat while Irfana’s flow and rhymes stand out. The song is also a tribute to South Indian film icon Silk Smitha and appropriately brings out dominating bars from Irfana. – _D.B._

**The Lightyears Explode — “Pills”**

Mumbai pop/punk band [The Lightyears Explode](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=The+Lightyears+Explode) began teasing their sophomore full-length album _Suburban Prose_ earlier this year with the record’s lead single, the jittery and explosive “Pills.” The Lightyears Explode interject the song with distorted guitars, steely vocals, blitzing basslines and a high-octane chorus with jumpy drums that are a nod to their punk roots.– _D.B._

**Donn Bhat, Sakur Khan Sufi — “Swali Hu”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/hIdbNufpYZI/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

Nearly seven years after the release of the future-classic record _Connected_, [Donn Bhat](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Donn+Bhat) comes back just as evocative with the mystical and philosophizing vocals of [Sakur Khan Sufi](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Sakur+Khan+Sufi) on “Swali Hu.” Bhat always knows his way around making an entrancing beat, but this time, he also brings in Rajasthani folk elements alongside wiry guitar melodies that are seemingly informed by African desert blues. – _A.T._

**Bhayanak Maut — “Just a Metal Kid”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/QnyNXAbP50Y/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

Mumbai metallers [Bhayanak Maut](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Bhayanak+Maut) reference some of India’s best-known metal outfits such as [Demonic Resurrection](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Demonic+Resurrection), [Scribe](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Scribe), [Undying Inc](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Undying+Inc), [Inner Sanctum](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Inner+Sanctum), [Skyharbor](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Skyharbor) and [Providence](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Providence+) on their scorching track “Just a Metal Kid.” The song includes blistering guitars, pulsating drums, growls as well as rock band Indus Creed‘s frontman Uday Benegal singing a hooky vocal refrain. – _D.B._

**Kamakshi Khanna — “Breathe”**

New Delhi-bred and Mumbai-based singer-songwriter [Kamakshi Khanna](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Kamakshi+Khanna) kicked off the year with a resounding new single, the ukulele-aided “Breathe.” Apart from Khanna’s emotive vocals, the song also includes a string arrangement, heart-thumping drums and a crisp bass groove. **_–_** _D.B._

**Aditi Ramesh — “Filter Coffee”**

Bengaluru-based singer-songwriter [Aditi Ramesh](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Aditi+Ramesh)’s first release in two years came neatly wrapped in soul, R&B and pop with the caffeinated “Filter Coffee.” The song includes the artist’s witty lyricism, her mellifluous vocals as well as slick synths that drive the track. **–** _D.B._

**Gauley Bhai — “Aunty Ko Tato Bagaicha”**

![Loading video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/KuwD5ikdeyc/sddefault.jpg#404_is_fine)

The exploitation of natural resources in the name of development can have far-reaching effects and Bengaluru-based, Kalimpong/Kozhikode-bred band [Gauley Bhai](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Gauley+Bhai) shine a spotlight on the psychological toll that ecological problems can bring on “Aunty Ko Tato Bagaicha.” It’s metaphorized storytelling set to frantic, jazz-informed rhythms and unshakeable grooves that the band has championed since their 2019 album _Joro_. _– A.T._

**Dhanji, Neil Ck, Circle Tone — “Thaltej Blues”**

There’s something wholly challenging about listening to “Thaltej Blues,” in a good way. Where other hip-hop artists in the country are staying within their lane, Ahmedabad’s [Dhanji](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Dhanji+) is all about pushing in all directions. “2023 much more bayiyayiyounce,” he declares on the song that’s playful, raucous and centered around ideas of home and personal growth. _– A.T._

**Tech Panda x Kenzani, Rusha & Blizza — “Dilbar”**

Both producer duos [Tech Panda x Kenzani](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Tech+Panda+x+Kenzani+) and [Rusha & Blizza](https://rollingstoneindia.com/?s=Rusha+%26+Blizza) have spent years chipping away at perfecting the present-day “Indian electronic” sound so it was no surprise that when they teamed up for “Dilbar,” it was going to be a banger. The track takes a vocal hook, samples it and drops it into several different treatments in less than three minutes, making for a journeying dancefloor hit. _– A.T._
